llm.rationale: The pattern suggests prioritizing tests to provide earlier failure feedback. In a Go environment, this can be implemented by running a subset of tests or specific packages first. Since no historical failure data or specific test ranking is provided in the repository, I will implement a minimal change that separates the test execution into two stages: a fast 'smoke test' (running only the current package) followed by the full test suite. This adheres to the mechanism of reordering/prioritizing tests for early feedback while ensuring all original tests are still executed to satisfy the requirement of preserving all original commands and checks.
